##### Project general facts

V-Suites is a 19-story residential development which offers a contemporary approach to modern luxury and urban living. The project is designed around the concept of comfort, wellbeing, and refined living, creating a serene residential environment where every detail is focused on enhancing the everyday experience. Its visionary design combines a sophisticated atmosphere with practical spaces tailored to contemporary lifestyles.

The development features a range of amenities designed to support residents’ health, wellbeing, and daily comfort. These include a modern gym, a swimming pool, and a steam room, providing opportunities for relaxation and maintaining an active lifestyle. V-Suites also incorporates a dedicated co-working space, offering residents a convenient environment for working with the necessary level of comfort and professionalism.

The residences feature a visionary design that emphasizes luxury and a sense of wellbeing, creating a peaceful sanctuary within the dynamic city environment. The apartments are fully furnished and include fully equipped kitchens, providing a move-in-ready living experience that combines functionality, comfort, and contemporary style.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a dynamic and modern district in Dubai, known for its combination of residential towers, hotels, restaurants, and commercial developments. Located south of Downtown Dubai, the area offers a fast-paced urban lifestyle with convenient access to some of the city’s key destinations and attractions.

The district provides a wide range of lifestyle, dining, entertainment, and leisure opportunities. Business Bay regularly hosts various events and celebrations, while its numerous restaurants, cafes, and residential facilities create a lively atmosphere throughout the area. The combination of modern infrastructure and diverse amenities makes the district suitable for a variety of contemporary lifestyles.

Residents benefit from convenient access to international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and financial centres located within the wider area. Business Bay’s central position also provides easy connectivity to key parts of Dubai, allowing residents to combine convenient everyday living with access to the city’s business, entertainment, and leisure destinations.
